justification: Function only uses fixed netlink callback argument offsets and does not perform any unsafe memory operations on attacker-controlled data.
analysis: The function reads from netlink callback arguments (cb->args) which could be influenced by userspace, but does not perform any direct memory operations on attacker-controlled data. The function uses fixed offsets (IPSET_CB_ARG0, IPSET_CB_NET, IPSET_CB_INDEX) that are part of the netlink callback structure and not directly user-controllable. No arithmetic operations or memory allocations are performed that could lead to overflow/underflow or use-after-free issues.
